verdict.rationale: A managed ClickHouse service could plausibly publish an OpenAPI or equivalent spec for its management API, so this axis applies. The pack contains no such spec. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: an MCP server (docs-7), the native ClickHouse protocol/HTTP interface (docs-5), and machine-readable docs via llms.txt and docs.md (probes 1-2). None of these is a downloadable machine-readable API specification.
